summary: V5 features (personalised redesign, wall react/comment, save chat photos, coverage map, DM read receipts) validated end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 new pytest cases PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_v5_features.py — wall 🌿×2 + ❤️ reactions increment and persist in GET /api/wall; empty emoji -> 400; comment append with 🌿 emoji, visible via GET; empty comment -> 400; DM read flag flips to true only after recipient GETs /api/messages/{sender_id} (Cara opens -> test_user sees read=true); /api/projects/{id}/gallery add persists in GET /api/projects/{id}; /api/map/contractors returns coverage_miles + reachable + distance_km (Manchester nearest ~0.7km & reachable); POST /api/projects/{id}/redesign with full payload (changes, style, garden_type=small urban patio, mood=calm, colour_scheme=greens and cream, ornaments[], must_haves, wishlist=[Ego mower, Weber Q1200 BBQ]) returns wishlist items as FIRST two hotspots with retailer='B&Q' and diy.com URL, remaining are AI-generated products; filters persisted on design doc. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): Community wall shows the 5-emoji reaction bar (❤️🌿😍👏🐝) with tappable counts (heart 0→1 after tap); comments modal opens on tap, shows author + text list, emoji quick-insert row (❤️🌿😍👏🐝) prepends to input, posted comment 'lovely v5!' appears in list. /map screen rendered correctly with SVG 'Who reaches you 🎯' (red You dot centre, green ring for reachable Blossom & Bee ~0.7km, grey rings for out-of-range) + 'Sorted by distance' list with km badges (0.7, 56.8, 113.7, 261.9 km) + graceful 'Map preview unavailable' fallback for the external static-map panel (expected — sandbox blocks the host). DM thread with Cara Clover shows 'Seen' tick under my sent messages (including the just-sent TEST_ v5 read message from pytest) — read receipts working live. Critical bug FIXED during test: /app/frontend/src/components/ImageViewer.tsx was using <Text> for the 'Save to project' label but NOT importing Text from react-native — added Text to the react-native import (single-line change). Deprecated packages detected: none new. Non-blocking react-native-web warnings persist from v2/v3: 'shadow*' style props (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents (use style.pointerEvents).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: <Text> used for 'Save to project' button label but Text was not imported from react-native (would crash the modal when onSave present). Added Text to the react-native import.

On initial load of a project detail screen, the new personalisation fields (gtype-*, mood-*, colour-*, ornament-*, wishlist-input, add-wishlist, must-haves-input, generate-button) were not detected in the DOM — likely they live below the fold and require scroll, or the redesign panel opens on a toggle. Main agent should confirm the panel is visible/expanded by default and that scrolling to it works on mobile. Backend confirms the fields are wired end-to-end.

issues: Carried over from v2/v3: react-native-web deprecation warnings for 'shadow*' style props and 'props.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking.

Static OpenStreetMap host still unreachable from preview sandbox (ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED); graceful 'Map preview unavailable — distances shown below' fallback works and the new SVG CoverageMap renders correctly, so not a defect.

action_items: Confirm the project-redesign panel (Garden type / Mood / Colour scheme / Ornaments / Wishlist input+add / Must-haves / Generate button) is actually rendered and reachable via scroll on the project detail screen (fields not detected on initial load in Playwright DOM query — likely below the fold; verify by scrolling the project screen).

Optional polish: (1) suppress shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings by migrating to boxShadow and style.pointerEvents; (2) server.py is now 1450 lines — long past the 700-line threshold, please split into routers (auth, projects, messaging, admin, maps, community, ai); (3) MessageCreate/RoomMessageCreate/CommentInput text still unbounded — recommend a 2000 char cap; (4) /api/wall/{id}/react does not de-duplicate per user — every tap increments (matches spec 'counts' but consider per-user toggle for like semantics later).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1450 lines — high priority to refactor into routers for maintainability.
In-process _geo_cache never expires and isn't shared across replicas — move to Mongo/Redis at scale.
wall react endpoint uses $inc without per-user tracking — a bot could spam the counter; consider a per-user reactions map.
ImageViewer.tsx missing Text import was a P0 crash risk that only surfaced when onSave prop was present — worth adding an ESLint rule for react-native-imports and a smoke test on the modal.

Redesign hotspot generator picks a RANDOM retailer per AI product (RETAILERS[random.choice]) — the request spec says wishlist items are B&Q (correct) but AI products get any retailer; UI copy 'Shop at B&Q' assumes B&Q but the retailer varies. Confirm the CTA reads the actual hotspot.retailer.
Report model still accepts any reason string; consider fixed enum.

rca_of_issue: Bug found & fixed during test: ImageViewer.tsx rendered <Text> without importing it from react-native. Reproduction: opening a chat/DM photo bubble (dm-image-*) with an onSave handler would mount the Modal and try to render <Text style={styles.saveText}>Save to project</Text>, throwing 'Text is not defined' and rendering a red screen on native / undefined component on web. Mitigation: added Text to the react-native import in /app/frontend/src/components/ImageViewer.tsx line 2. Verified the file compiles after supervisor restart (no metro errors).
